title: build draft <file> checks a build file and keeps its bytes as .jitso/drafts/<id>.yaml (a .yml input too); the draft is not listed as a launchable build
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). `jitso build draft <file.yaml|->` reads a build file (a path ending in .yaml or .yml, at most 64 KiB), checks it with the build rules of the draft layer, and writes the input bytes unchanged to `.jitso/drafts/<id>.yaml` (always the .yaml name, whatever the input was called). It prints `drafted <id>: .jitso/drafts/<id>.yaml (launch it with --build <id>; only the owner can save it)` and exits 0. A draft is never a launchable build: the default `build list` does not show it and prints nothing on stderr for a valid one.
